capability: Agent 直接调用 `sivtr_search` / `sivtr_show` / `sivtr_zoom` / `sivtr_filter` / `sivtr_status`，不用你粘贴日志。

- **一个搜索面覆盖本地工作**：终端输出 + 所有已注册 Agent provider

outputs: WorkRecord | 一个有用的工作事件：终端命令、Agent turn、工具调用或捕获输出块。 |
WorkPart | Record 里的命令、输出、assistant 回复、tool output 或 error。只想拿有用片段而不是整个事件时用它。 |
WorkRef | 某段精确记忆的稳定地址，例如 `pi/<session>/3/p1`。适合引用、复现和交接。 |
WorkSet | `@last`、`@failures` 这类记忆变量背后的数据：一组有顺序的 refs，可以筛选、保存、切片、管道传递、导航、扩展和展示。 |

capability: `ios_sim_screenshot` | Capture a PNG and return a small JSON summary (path, bytes, dimensions, device); the image renders in the card/panel, never as an image block.
`ios_sim_list_apps` | List the apps INSTALLED on a booted simulator or a connected phone (bundle id, display name, version, system flag)
`ios_sim_launch_app` | Launch an installed app on a booted simulator or a connected phone — by `bundleId`, or by `name`
`ios_sim_ui_rows` | Read the visible list/feed rows of the frontmost app as rows instead of a raw tree
`ios_sim_wait_for` | Wait until text appears or disappears on the screen
`ios_sim_logs` | Read what a simulator app prints, from the device unified log
`ios_sim_processes` | List the running app processes of one simulator from its own launchd
`ios_sim_backtrace` | One-shot batch LLDB (attach → thread backtrace → detach, never interactive)
`ios_sim_leaks` | Analyze leaks with Xcode's `leaks` tool
`ios_sim_app_info` | Installed-app facts: app bundle path, writable data container, and Info.plist values
**Compact conversation cards.** Tool results render as one-line cards with no inline imagery
**Standard mode and Code Mode.** Standard sessions use the host-projected `presentationMeta`.

usecases: Use it when the accessibility tree is empty or degenerate, for text rendered as graphics (badge counts, prices baked into images), or to independently verify what is on screen.
outputs: **Sidebar panel — “iOS 模拟器”.** The live view lives in a persistent right-hand panel
**Status capsule above the input.** While the panel is closed and a stream is online, a small green-dot pill (`<device> · 实时`) appears above the composer and opens the panel when clicked.
`ios_sim_ui_tree` | Dump the frontmost app's accessibility element tree (labels, identifiers, values, frames in device points) plus the screen size in points
Captures a fresh screenshot and returns `{device, size, items:[{text, confidence, rect}]}`
`memgraph` (a `.memgraph` artifact to open in Xcode Instruments, never parsed here)
reliability: On non-macOS hosts (or when serve-sim is unresolvable) the tools stay registered but fail with an explanatory error
A FAILED listing throws (e.g. "the device is not reachable by CoreDevice") instead of returning an empty list, so `count: 0` always means the device really has no matching app.
On failure the result carries the filtered `xcodebuild` error tail.
output is capped at ~40 KB (deepest levels pruned, `truncated` + hint set).
an out-of-range index FAILS (never clamps).
if the key is not among the row's parsed counters the tap is REFUSED before it happens — a real-device tap is never a probe.
A timeout is a normal `matched:false` answer, never an error
Tokens are HMAC-SHA256 capabilities (`base64url(payload).base64url(mac)`) expiring within 10 minutes
with zero consumers the stream stops automatically after 5 minutes. Intentional stops are never fought.
**`ios_sim_leaks` on iOS 26.2 simulators** — on iOS 26.2 runtimes, Xcode's `leaks` can fail to inspect simulator processes
concerns: Install and development commands were excluded.
Prompt-to-tool arrows in Quick start were not counted as ioPairs because they do not show an output or response.
Only the overview image was present; the logo was excluded as decorative.
